summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py (SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path) and test/test_extras/test_extras_shacl.py. Tests: test/test_extras/test_extras_shacl.py and test/test_path.py pass (36 passed) with the shared venv. Not run: mypy and black, which are not installed in that venv, so type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading only. Deviation: a non-node guard (isinstance against Node) rejects None up front, because None as a graph lookup subject acts as a wildcard. Nothing committed; no existing files changed.
